text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One holiday, while working in the Trainer's Room to catch up on some tasks—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, dressed in her costume, suddenly made a playful biting gesture toward my arm.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see! With that, Big Brother has
become a vampire's... Rice's kin now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see! With that, Big Sister has
become a vampire's... Rice's kin now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So it has to be with Rice...
I want you to take time off work and come with me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The place Rice Shower brought me to
was an amusement park in the middle of the Halloween season.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, if you wear a costume,
you get in for free.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Big Brother, do you want to ride the roller coaster?
Or would you prefer the spinning teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Big Sister, do you want to ride the roller coaster?
Or would you prefer the spinning teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the popcorn over there
is honey pumpkin flavored!
Rice will go buy some...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's okay.
Onii-sama, you don't have to do anything today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's okay.
Onee-sama, you don't have to do anything today...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look! There's a line forming...
It must be a popular attraction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower pointed toward a long line. However,
at the end of it was the entrance to a haunted house
set inside a Western-style mansion...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...L-Let's go, dear brother!
Since we're here, we might as well enjoy the popular rides too, right...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...L-Let's go, dear sister!
Since we're here, we might as well enjoy the popular rides too, right...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worried about Rice Shower, who seemed to be putting on a brave face,
I stepped into line...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's s-so dark, isn't it...?
B-Big Brother... aren't you scared...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's s-so dark, isn't it...?
B-Big Sister... aren't you scared...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Rice is okay!
I-I mean, today is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Skreee...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep, what was that sound...!?

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text:
Vvh, oaargh...
Gahh, vvvhh...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeek!!
I-I'm surrounded by ghosts...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to step forward
to protect the frightened Rice Shower—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "N-No...! Today, Rice is going to save you, Big Brother...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "N-No...! Today, Rice is going to save you, Big Sister...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother works so hard for Rice every single day! So...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister works so hard for Rice every single day! So...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... for this whole day! I just want you to
have fun and get some rest, Dear Brother...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... for this whole day! I just want you to
have fun and get some rest, Dear Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Rice Shower invited me to the amusement
park like this to comfort me for working even on my days off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What should I say to her...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What should I say to her...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Familiar...? 
...Ah, because Rice gave you a little chomp...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Shielding Rice Shower along the way, I guided her safely to the haunted house exit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm so sorry...
Rice was supposed to be the one treating you...
choice_data_list: You've already given me plenty to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, hey.
I want you to stay by my side forever and ever, Big Brother."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, hey.
I want you to stay by my side forever and ever, Big Sister."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't push yourself too hard...
If you don't get enough rest, umm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might just bite you and turn you into one of us again...
Just kidding, ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having received such heartfelt hospitality from Rice Shower, I promised her that I wouldn't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...! That's right, Rice is
a vampire right now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I-I am a vampire...
I-I'm super scary, rawr~...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, he sucks blood, and...
well, he turns into mist to sneak up on you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And, and... if you look me in the eye, you'll turn to stone...
and I can cast amazing spells, too...
I'm a s-scary vampire, roar~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ......Alright!

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, ow...
S-So... sca... ry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, the ghosts went away...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother, let's go while we still have the chance...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister, let's go while we still have the chance...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... My heart was beating so fast...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Onii-sama? Weren't you scared?
Did you... have fun...?"
choice_data_list: Thanks to a strong vampire, that is.
Thanks to a strong vampire, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Onee-sama? Weren't you scared?
Did you... have fun...?"
choice_data_list: Thanks to a strong vampire, that is.
Thanks to a strong vampire, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ehehe, what a relief...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though clearly embarrassed, Rice Shower still wore a delighted smile on her face.
